name: add_k8s_pod_disruption_budget
description: Authors a PodDisruptionBudget guaranteeing availability of the web Deployment during voluntary disruptions
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml (already present, do not modify it) runs 3 replicas of the 'web' Deployment, labeled app: web. Create k8s/pdb.yaml defining a PodDisruptionBudget so voluntary disruptions (node drains, cluster upgrades) never take down more than one replica at a time: apiVersion policy/v1, kind PodDisruptionBudget, metadata.name `web-pdb`, spec.minAvailable set to an INTEGER of at least 2 (so at least 2 of the 3 replicas always stay up), and spec.selector.matchLabels matching the Deployment's pod labels exactly (app: web) so it actually applies to those pods.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: myorg/web:1.2.3
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

test_setup_files.test_pdb.py:
import yaml

with open('k8s/pdb.yaml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert d.get('apiVersion') == 'policy/v1', d.get('apiVersion')
assert d.get('kind') == 'PodDisruptionBudget', d.get('kind')
assert d.get('metadata', {}).get('name') == 'web-pdb', d.get('metadata')

spec = d['spec']
min_available = spec.get('minAvailable')
assert isinstance(min_available, int), f'minAvailable must be an integer, got {min_available!r}'
assert min_available >= 2, f'minAvailable must be >= 2 (out of 3 replicas), got {min_available}'

match_labels = spec.get('selector', {}).get('matchLabels')
assert match_labels == {'app': 'web'}, f'selector.matchLabels must be exactly {{app: web}}, got {match_labels!r}'

# the Deployment itself must be untouched
with open('k8s/deployment.yaml') as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)
assert dep['spec']['replicas'] == 3, 'deployment.yaml was modified (replicas)'
assert dep['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels'] == {'app': 'web'}, 'deployment.yaml was modified (labels)'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.k8s/pdb.yaml:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: web-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
